questions.prompt: About how many people lack safely managed drinking water?
questions.explain: 2.1 billion people, about 1 in 4, per the 2025 WHO/UNICEF update.

questions.prompt: Why did Midtown Atlanta lose safe tap water in June 2024?
options: A chemical spill hit the river
questions.explain: Mains from 1910 and 1930 broke; the last advisory lifted six days later.

questions.prompt: Proctor Creek drains into which river, Atlanta's main water supply?
questions.explain: Proctor Creek flows into the Chattahoochee, metro Atlanta's main water supply.

questions.prompt: How is southwest Georgia easing drought-year pressure on its streams?
options: Piping in water from Lake Lanier
Moving irrigation to deep aquifer wells
questions.explain: A $49.8 million grant funds about 242 deep wells, plus stream monitoring.

questions.prompt: How much should the 80-acre EcoCommons cut campus stormwater runoff?
questions.explain: The EcoCommons is designed to cut campus stormwater runoff by 50%.
